title: Andro Sphinx TagDuel 2v2 adapter
scope: Project only the active physical representative's private hand.
Project both shared team fields with 3 Monster Zones, 3 Spell/Trap Zones and a separate Field Zone.
Keep physical owner UID distinct from team controller seat.
Plan and revalidate the 500 shared-LP Special Summon while the team's Pyramid of Light is face-up.
Enforce the no-attack turn after Normal/Special Summon.
Resolve the half-ATK battle damage trigger from an immutable event snapshot, with duplicate-event protection.

implementation.reason: src/monsterEffects.ts and src/duelEngineCurrent.ts remain under M61 handoff; this PR exposes a tested adapter contract without editing reserved runtime files.

cases: shared LP and Field Zone mapping
500 LP summon cost and stale-plan revalidation
wrong-position, non-battle, friendly, negated and duplicate-event rejection

catalog.note: Adapter tests are not card certification. The card is not added to the executable registry or distribution allowlist.
